items.title: Next-Gen GST Process Reforms
items.summary: Towards Simpler, Faster and More Predictable Processes 09 OCT 2026 9:58PM by PIB Delhi Introduced on 1 July 2017, GST brought many Central and State taxes into a common framework. It marked a milestone in India’s reform journey. It gave effect to the principle of “ One Nation, One Tax” and helped move India towards an integrated tax system.

facts.text: GST in Numbers: Wider Reach, Scale and Collections A wider taxpayer base: Registered taxpayers increased from around 60 lakh in 2017 to ~1.70 crore as of September 2026.
A large-scale digital tax system: As on 30 September 2026, the GST System had cumulatively processed 3,053 crore invoice uploads and 833.82 crore e-way bills.
Strong revenue growth: Gross GST collections reached ~₹12.46 lakh crore during April-September 2026 , registering an increase of 11.6% Y-o-Y.
For eg: If a manufacturer has paid tax of ₹10,000 on raw material purchase and collected tax of ₹25,000 on product sales.

bullets: Direct tax: impact and incidence fall on the same person, cannot be shifted; administered by CBDT (Central Boards of Revenue Act, 1963). Indirect tax: collected by an intermediary (seller) and passed on to the consumer through price; administered by CBIC.

bullets: Income originating: value produced within the State's boundaries (this is GSDP). Income accruing = State income + income of the State's residents earned in other States/abroad.

GSDP is computed across 9 sectors (APPSC-G2 2017). These are the old CSO classification: agriculture-forestry-fishing; mining; manufacturing; electricity-gas-water; construction; trade-hotels; transport-storage-communication; finance-real estate; community and social services .
GVA (basic prices, industry-wise) + product taxes - product subsidies = GSDP (market prices). NSDP = GSDP - depreciation, and AP's per capita income is based on NSDP.
Directorate of Economics & Statistics (DES), AP compiles GSDP; at State level the DESs compile State Domestic Product; for GSDP the economy is divided into 9 sectors (G2 2017).

MoSPI issued a uniform guideline for compiling GSVA (base 2022-23) in May 2026: integrate administrative records, sector databases and surveys; better capture of services and the unincorporated segment; consistency with national accounts (LENSD, 9 May 2026).

bullets: The port opened in 1933 . It is the deepest landlocked and protected harbour (APPSC 2025 key), with both natural and artificial harbours. Its outer harbour serves iron ore exports and it has a crude oil berth; it is called the "Brightest Jewel" (APP).
Dolphin's Nose on the Yarada hills gives the harbour natural protection (APP).
It set a record of 91.17 MMT in 2025-26, up 10.34% (TH, 10 May 2026). It is India's top seafood-export port, handling 5.12 lakh tonnes, over 26% of India's 19.32 lakh tonnes (MPEDA, FY26).

bullets: Sagarmala was launched in 2015 by MoPSW for port-led development. Its 5 pillars are port modernisation, port connectivity, port-led industrialisation, coastal community development, and coastal shipping with IWT (VIS). It has 800+ projects worth about Rs 5.8 lakh crore (IYB 2026). Coastal shipping grew 118% in a decade (VIS 2026).
Sagarmala 2.0 (2025) covers shipbuilding, repair, breaking and recycling (VIS).

Maritime India Vision 2030 (launched 2021) has 150+ initiatives and aims to put India among the top 10 maritime nations. It feeds into the Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047, which targets 10 billion tonnes per annum of port capacity (LENS).
MoPSW is building it as Asia's largest maritime heritage museum. India and the Netherlands signed an MoU on it in 2026 (APPCA).
2025 laws include the Merchant Shipping Act, Coastal Shipping Act and Indian Ports Act (ES). The Ministry was renamed MoPSW in 2020 (IYB).

Web 3.0 is the third-generation, decentralised web. DeFi offers lending and trading through smart contracts without banks . Tokenisation turns ownership rights in an asset into a blockchain token (LENS Jun 2026).

items.title: Commerce Secretary Shri Rajesh Agrawal Highlights Need for Rigorous Legal Thinking at CTIL’s 9th Anniversary Celebration
items.summary: He noted that rigorous legal thinking was more important than ever and that CTIL, as a leading institution in the field, was well placed to contribute to it. Commerce Secretary Shri Rajesh Agrawal, congratulated CTIL on completing nine years and noted that the Centre had earned the trust of the Government, industry and the wider trade law community through its sustained and rigorous work.

facts.text: He recalled CTIL’s contributions to the Department of Commerce through legal analysis and specialised support in free trade agreement negotiations, dispute settlement and institutional memory building.

Additional Secretary, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Shri Yashvir Singh, delivered the Special Address and highlighted CTIL’s contributions to India’s major trade engagements, including support for major free trade agreements and engagements such as the G20 and BRICS over the past several years.

Joint Secretary, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Smt. Kapil Chaudhary, highlighted CTIL’s expanding research in emerging areas, including critical minerals, semiconductors, artificial intelligence, supply chains, climate and sustainability.

bullets: Qubit can be 0, 1 or any state between (superposition); entanglement links qubits regardless of distance; decoherence (loss of quantum state through the environment) is the main barrier (TH, 9 Jul 2026).
Entanglement sudden death = abrupt total loss of entanglement; Raman Research Institute showed one well-timed local "quantum flip" can delay or prevent it (LENS daily, 16 Sep 2026).
Applications: cryptography, drug discovery, climate modelling, optimisation; Shor's algorithm can break public-key cryptography; "Q-Day" = when this becomes possible.
DST quantum-safe report: post-quantum cryptography migration for Critical Information Infrastructure by 2029, others by 2033 (LENS daily, 31 May 2026).

bullets: GST stands for Goods and Services Tax.
The basic principle of GST is taxation on the supply of goods and services.
GST revenue ultimately accrues to the jurisdiction where goods or services are consumed.
GST revenue does not accrue based on where goods or services are produced.
The GST Council is a constitutional body.

bullets: "Backward Classes" is not defined in the Constitution (APPSC G2 2017 key: the "defined" statement is the wrong one).

27% OBC quota in central jobs from 1993; in central educational institutions under the CEI (Reservation in Admission) Act, 2006, in force Jan 2007 (IYB 2026 says 2007) after the 2005 amendment to Art. 15 (IYB) [GK for the Act's year].

sections.topic: Indra Sawhney and creamy layer link to NCBC
sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-3 › National Commission for SCs (338), STs (338A) and Backward Classes (338B); Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (350B) › Indra Sawhney and creamy layer link to NCBC
bullets: *Indra Sawhney v UoI* (16 Nov 1992) upheld 27% OBC reservation, introduced the creamy layer, and directed a permanent body for OBC-list inclusion/exclusion → NCBC Act, 1993 (in force 2 April 1993).
102nd Amendment Act, 2018 inserted Art. 338B - NCBC became constitutional; composition: Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and 3 members appointed by the President; civil court powers.
The 102nd Amendment also removed backward classes from the NCSC's purview .
105th Amendment, 2021 restored the States' power to prepare their own SEBC lists (after the Maratha quota judgment) .
Niranjan Jyoti appointed NCBC Chairperson in 2026 (APPCA 2026).

sections.topic: Transgender persons · Reservation and state measures
sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-5 › Transgender persons - NALSA judgment, Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act 2019 › Reservation and state measures - horizontal vs vertical, first service quota, AP pensions, welfare board, ID cards
bullets: Debate: NALSA (2014) asked governments to treat transgender persons as socially and educationally backward (a vertical OBC-type quota); the community seeks horizontal reservation cutting across SC/ST/OBC/General. The issue resurfaced in June 2023 with a Mumbai protest against Maharashtra's reply to the Bombay High Court (APPSC 2022).
Karnataka - first State to give 1% reservation to transgender persons in all government services (July 2021) (APPSC 2023).
Andhra Pradesh: Measure 3,125 transgender certificates issued via the National Portal (CDI on APSES 2025-26)

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-4 › Regionalism - meaning, causes, forms and sons-of-the-soil movements › Domicile-based job reservation laws - private-sector local quotas and court rulings
bullets: Local job reservation is argued to contradict Articles 14, 15, 16 and 19, which guarantee equality, non-discrimination on place of birth and freedom of movement/occupation across India.

Art. 16(2) bars discrimination in public employment on grounds including place of birth and residence; Art. 16(3) lets only Parliament prescribe a residence requirement (Public Employment (Requirement as to Residence) Act, 1957).
AP Employment of Local Candidates in the Industries/Factories Act, 2019: Quota 75% of private industrial jobs for locals; Status First such state law; challenged in AP High Court
Haryana State Employment of Local Candidates Act, 2020: Quota 75% of private jobs up to a salary ceiling; Status Struck down by the Punjab & Haryana High Court (Nov 2023) as unconstitutional
Exam angle: APPSC-G2 2025 asked which state's 75% private-sector local quota was struck down by the High Court - Haryana.

items.title: IMD conducts Training Workshop on Cyclone and Marine Weather Warning Services for users
items.summary: 09 OCT 2026 7:09PM by PIB Delhi The India Meteorological Department (IMD) conducted a training workshop on “Familiarisation of cyclone warning and marine weather services” for stakeholders, disaster managers and media representatives. The training programme received an overwhelming response. More than 650 stakeholders joined the training programme.

facts.text: 09 OCT 2026 7:09PM by PIB Delhi The India Meteorological Department (IMD) conducted a training workshop on “Familiarisation of cyclone warning and marine weather services” for stakeholders, disaster managers and media representatives.

IMD experts delivered presentations on cyclone warning services and marine meteorological services , covering various forecast products and warning bulletins for coastal communities, fishermen, ports and maritime stakeholders.
It is an integrated platform supporting timely decision-making by the public, stakeholders and disaster managers.

sections.topic: Election Commission of India · Disputes regarding election
sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-3 › Election Commission of India - composition, appointment (2023 Act), powers and functions › Disputes regarding election - EC vs courts, Article 329 bar
bullets: Art. 329(a): laws on delimitation and allotment of seats cannot be questioned in court; Art. 329(b): an election can be challenged only by an election petition .

By convention courts do not interfere once the poll process begins; the ECI cannot review a result. Petitions go to the High Court (Parliament, state legislatures) and the Supreme Court for President/VP (Art. 71) (UPSC).

Art. 329(b): an election to Parliament or a state legislature can be questioned only by an election petition under the RPA 1951. Such petitions are tried by the High Court, with appeal to the Supreme Court .
President/VP election disputes: decided by the Supreme Court (Art. 71) .
The ECI does not try election petitions. It decides party and symbol disputes and advises on disqualification.

sections.where: Prep notes · Book 2 Polity, Society & IR › B-3 › Recognition of national and state parties - criteria and the Symbols Order › Election Symbols Order 1968 - reserved vs free symbols, split disputes (Sadiq Ali)
bullets: Reserved symbols: exclusively for recognised parties (e.g. Lotus - BJP, Hand - INC); two recognised parties in different States may hold the same symbol.
Free symbols: for RUPPs and independents, allotted from a notified list; latest list May 2025 - 184 symbols (LENSD, 11 Jun 2026).
RUPPs get a common symbol if they contest 2 Lok Sabha seats or 5% of Assembly seats (LENSD, 11 Sep 2026).

Split disputes: Para 15 - the ECI decides which faction is the party, applying the Sadiq Ali (1971) test of majority [GK for the test] (TH, 16 Jun 2026); the ECI acts as a court in recognition and symbol disputes.
Para 16A: the ECI may suspend or withdraw recognition for defying the Model Code of Conduct (TH, 5 May 2026).

Reservation has also broadened the urban middle class by bringing in backward classes and Dalits (APP).
Occupational mobility: e.g., Ezhavas of Kerala moved from toddy tapping into tailoring and cottage industries (APP).
Migration and urbanisation: city anonymity and caste-blind public spaces weaken caste identity, but migrants carry caste networks and prejudices into cities (APP).
